wireRules.wireLong: Long values with -9007199254740991 < value < 9007199254740991 serialize as JSON number; boundary and out-of-range values serialize as an unformatted decimal JSON string
wireRules.wireDateTime: non-negative epoch milliseconds serialized with wireLong

visibility.projectFact: ProjectScopeApi.ACTION_VIEW for trusted actor and tenant

metricRules.rejectedPendingModificationCount: COUNT_DISTINCT_TASK_ID where currentStage=P4 and taskStatus=PLAN_DRAFTING and current non-replaced approval instance status=REJECTED

todoCount.basePredicate: taskOrigin=NEW_PLATFORM and taskStatus!=ARCHIVED and project is ACTION_VIEW visible
todoCount.guardRule: reuse the existing server-side action guards including current state, owner qualification, function permission, project scope, source comparability, revision, completeness, hold and node state
todoCount.p5Rule: existing myTodos eligibility intersected with KPI ACTION_VIEW visible projects

metricRules.overlap: metrics are independently defined and may overlap; never sum them as a total

controlledSubstituteBoundary: test-scoped deterministic cross-context facts may exercise the normal CUT aggregation; no production Fake/fallback/empty-success provider and no substitute-based Implementation Done evidence
